snapshot.title: Normalize spacing for buttons, text, and panels on core scenes
snapshot.description: Address feedback on inconsistent spacing by tightening and standardizing layout spacing in Earth navigation and mining HUD/action controls while keeping existing visual identity.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Earth base navigation buttons have consistent spacing and tap targets
Mining HUD/panels/buttons use consistent gaps and offsets
No overlap or cramped controls on mobile-width viewport
